name: quizway-api
description: QuizWay backend — NestJS gRPC microservices (gateway, auth, quiz, worker).

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.dev:auth: npm run build:packages && npm run start:dev -w @quizway/auth-service
scripts.dev:quiz: npm run build:packages && npm run start:dev -w @quizway/quiz-service
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:packages && npm run start:dev -w @quizway/worker
scripts.dev:gateway: npm run build:packages && npm run start:dev -w @quizway/gateway
